methodology: The $2,000 floor uses the current 1-cent-per-mile travel redemption. The independent $3,200–$3,700 benchmark applies current 1.6–1.85-cent transfer-partner valuations to 200,000 miles; it is a comparison tool, not a promised return. Trip-specific upside shows the itinerary's cash airfare that an award could displace before award taxes, carrier surcharges, positioning flights, bags and seats.

capitalOne.label: Capital One transfer partners and ratios

flyingBlue.label: Flying Blue reward-ticket rules and monthly promos

albania.cashImpact: Best case: displace the itinerary's $5,200 outer-airfare allowance before award charges; the Corfu ferry remains cash.
albania.backup: Compare Aeroplan for Star Alliance space into Tirana and home from Corfu. Its higher mileage can still win if Flying Blue cannot produce four seats on both dates.

balkans.route: PIT → Dubrovnik or Tirana / Corfu → PIT
balkans.cashImpact: Best case: displace $3,800–$5,400 of planned outer airfare before award charges.
balkans.backup: Use Aeroplan to test Star Alliance service at Dubrovnik, Tirana and Corfu; preserve the itinerary's cross-border car rules when choosing the arrival airport.

california-pacific-coast.route: PIT → San Diego / San Francisco → PIT
california-pacific-coast.cashImpact: Awards could displace the $1,400–$2,800 flight line before taxes; the fixed-value fallback can instead erase $2,000 across flights, hotels or the rental car.
california-pacific-coast.backup: If United/Aeroplan space is poor, compare cash open-jaw fares first. This is one of the few trips where a cheap cash fare can beat a transfer.

canary-islands.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $4,400 outer-airfare allowance before award charges; keep the $620 Tenerife–La Palma flights in cash.
canary-islands.backup: Compare British Airways or Finnair Avios for Iberia routings via Madrid, but reject an award that adds a fragile self-transfer.

crete.cashImpact: Best case: replace much of the current $8,350–$8,800 flight, seat and bag allowance. Award taxes, seats and bags remain cash.
crete.backup: Compare Aeroplan for Air Canada, Lufthansa, SWISS, Aegean or United combinations. Require one protected itinerary on each direction.

croatia.cashImpact: Best case: displace $5,600–$6,800 of planned open-jaw airfare before award charges.
croatia.backup: Aeroplan can expose Star Alliance inventory through Frankfurt, Munich, Vienna or Zurich; compare the whole itinerary, not isolated legs.

dolomites-sardinia.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,400–$7,000 transatlantic allowance before award charges; keep the Venice–Olbia hop in cash unless it prices efficiently on points.
dolomites-sardinia.backup: Compare Aeroplan into Venice and out of Olbia, plus Avios for the Italian positioning flight. Do not spend transferable miles on a cheap hop by default.

greece-cyclades.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,000 Athens airfare allowance before award charges; keep the $300 Milos–Athens flight in cash.
greece-cyclades.backup: Aeroplan is the practical second search for Aegean, Air Canada, Lufthansa, SWISS, Turkish or United space to Athens.

greece-ionian.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,600–$6,700 multi-city airfare allowance before award charges.
greece-ionian.backup: Compare Aeroplan into Kefalonia and out of Athens. Keep the corrected Athens exit and its ground-transfer buffer intact.

greece-via-lisbon.route: PIT → Lisbon / Chania or Athens → PIT
greece-via-lisbon.cashImpact: Best case: displace the outer-ticket share of the $5,200–$8,200 flight stack; Lisbon–Crete and other intra-Europe legs may remain cash.
greece-via-lisbon.backup: Compare Aeroplan and TAP Miles&Go for the Portugal direction, then Aeroplan for the Greece return. Price the open jaw before moving any miles.

hawaii.cashImpact: Awards could displace the $3,600–$4,400 mainland flight line before taxes; keep the $300–$600 Honolulu–Kona hop in cash unless an award is unusually cheap.
hawaii.backup: Turkish charges 25,000 miles one way for eligible nonstop partner flights to Hawaii, but this PIT route needs connections; use it only if the ticketing rules work for the exact itinerary.

iceland.cashImpact: Use 200,000 miles to erase $2,000 of the $2,600–$3,600 family airfare or another eligible travel charge. That leaves only $600–$1,600 of the planned flight line in cash.
iceland.backup: Aeroplan starts at 32,500 points one way in this distance band, so 200,000 points do not cover eight seats. Transfer only if a live award beats the $2,000 fallback after taxes.

iceland-ischia-cilento.cashImpact: Preserve the full 200,000-mile balance while the broken air construction is rebuilt. The eventual award could displace part of the current $3,600–$4,800 flight allowance; today that saving is unproven.
iceland-ischia-cilento.backup: After the route is valid, compare an Aeroplan stopover construction with Flying Blue open jaws. Until then, the only dependable value is a later $2,000 travel credit.

italy-salento-amalfi.cashImpact: Best case: displace $5,200–$7,200 of planned open-jaw airfare before award charges.
italy-salento-amalfi.backup: Compare Aeroplan through Star Alliance gateways and Avios for British Airways or Iberia options, while preserving a protected Naples return.

madeira-crete.cashImpact: Best case: replace the outer-ticket share of the $7,000–$8,200 all-flight allowance; Madeira–Lisbon and Lisbon–Crete may remain cash.
madeira-crete.backup: Compare Aeroplan for the Crete direction and TAP Miles&Go for Portugal. Keep the Lisbon weather-buffer night even if awards change carriers.

madeira-kefalonia.cashImpact: Best case: replace a substantial share of the current $8,000–$9,000 family air band; the Madeira–Kefalonia bridge may remain cash.
madeira-kefalonia.backup: Compare Aeroplan for the Greece direction and TAP Miles&Go for Madeira. Do not transfer until all four seats and the island bridge are workable.

madeira-mallorca.cashImpact: Best case: replace the outer-ticket share of the $6,700–$7,500 all-flight allowance; short Portugal–Mallorca legs may remain cash.
madeira-mallorca.backup: Compare Avios for Iberia service from Mallorca and TAP Miles&Go for Madeira, but keep the Lisbon wind buffer in the route.

madeira-sicily.cashImpact: Best case: replace the outer-ticket share of the $5,900–$6,800 all-flight allowance; the Lisbon and Palermo links may remain cash.
madeira-sicily.backup: Compare Aeroplan for the Sicily return and TAP Miles&Go for Madeira. A cheap easyJet hop should usually be paid in cash.

maui-kauai.cashImpact: Awards could displace the $3,200–$4,400 mainland flight line before taxes; keep the $250–$500 Maui–Kauai hop in cash unless award value is exceptional.
maui-kauai.backup: Turkish's 25,000-mile Hawaii rate is limited to eligible nonstop partner awards. Aeroplan is the cleaner first search for a protected connecting trip from Pittsburgh.

portugal.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,300–$6,200 outer-airfare allowance before award charges; keep the $390–$785 Faro–Madeira flight in cash.
portugal.backup: Compare Aeroplan for Air Canada or TAP-operated space and TAP Miles&Go for the Portugal-heavy route. Preserve the open jaw instead of paying to backtrack.

portugal-algarve-sicily.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,200–$6,200 outer open-jaw allowance before award charges; the Faro–Palermo bridge remains cash.
portugal-algarve-sicily.backup: Compare Aeroplan for both ends. Keep the live Lisbon–Rome connection rather than reviving the unavailable Barcelona routing.

portugal-crete.cashImpact: Best case: replace the outer-ticket share of the $4,800–$5,900 all-flight allowance; Lisbon–Chania may remain cash.
portugal-crete.backup: Compare Aeroplan for the Crete return and TAP Miles&Go for Lisbon. Require protection across every paid connection.

portugal-sicily.cashImpact: Best case: replace the outer-ticket share of the $5,200–$5,800 all-flight allowance; Lisbon–Palermo may remain cash.
portugal-sicily.backup: Compare Aeroplan for the Sicily return and TAP Miles&Go for Lisbon. Keep the Monday one-stop Sicily bridge in the plan.

sardinia-corsica.cashImpact: Best case: displace $5,400–$6,400 of planned open-jaw airfare before award charges.
sardinia-corsica.backup: Compare Flying Blue access via mainland Europe with Aeroplan Star Alliance options. Do not let an award force a Corsica backtrack.

sicily-malta.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $4,000–$5,200 outer open-jaw allowance before award charges; keep the $250–$500 Catania–Malta hop in cash.
sicily-malta.backup: Compare Aeroplan into Sicily and out of Malta. Preserve one protected transatlantic ticket in each direction.

slovenia-adriatic.cashImpact: Best case: displace $4,800–$6,400 of planned airfare before award charges.
slovenia-adriatic.backup: Aeroplan can search Air Canada, Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian and United combinations; compare Ljubljana with the Venice-drive fallback.

southern-france.cashImpact: Best case: displace $5,200–$6,800 of planned open-jaw airfare before award charges.
southern-france.backup: Flying Blue is especially natural here because Air France can serve both endpoints through Paris. Compare Standard and Flex if the Light fare is too restrictive.

spain.cashImpact: Best case: displace $2,900–$5,600 of planned open-jaw airfare before award charges.
spain.backup: Compare British Airways or Finnair Avios for Iberia and American inventory. A low cash fare near the bottom of the band may favor the $2,000 travel-credit fallback.

switzerland-crete.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,200 outer-airfare allowance before award charges; keep Zurich–Crete cash if its current fare stays low.
switzerland-crete.backup: Aeroplan is the strong second search for SWISS, Air Canada, Lufthansa, Aegean and United combinations.

switzerland-sicily.cashImpact: Best case: displace the $5,200 outer-airfare allowance before award charges; keep Zurich–Catania cash if its current fare stays low.
switzerland-sicily.backup: Compare Aeroplan for SWISS and other Star Alliance space, then Flying Blue for the Sicily return.

turkish-riviera.cashImpact: Best case: displace $7,000–$8,000 of planned open-jaw airfare before award charges.
turkish-riviera.backup: Turkish Miles&Smiles lists 40,000 miles one way at its North America–Türkiye promotional economy rate: 160,000 miles can cover one direction for all four if seats exist.
